etymologies.etymologyHTML: From moving (picture) +‎ -ie. Attested since at least 1912 (if not 1908), originally in American English.

definitions.definition: (chiefly Canada, US, Australia) A recorded sequence of images displayed on a screen at a rate sufficiently fast to create the appearance of motion; a film.
(usually in the plural, chiefly Canada, US, Australia) A cinema; a movie theatre.
(informal, figuratively) Any event, especially one that is unpleasant or tiresome.
